from aperture import read_json, parameters, write_json, write_csv
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
getcontext().prec = 40
cfg = parameters()
groups = {}
valid = 0
invalid = 0
missing_groups = 0
reasons = {}
examples = []
files = []
mapping = None
for name in cfg["input_names"]:
    report = read_json(name)
    if mapping is not None and report.get("mapping") != mapping:
        raise ValueError("Cannot combine reports with different column or numeric mappings")
    mapping = report.get("mapping")
    valid += report["valid_rows"]
    invalid += report["invalid_rows"]
    files += report.get("files", [name])
    quality = report.get("quality", {})
    missing_groups += quality.get("missing_category_rows", 0)
    examples = (examples + quality.get("examples", []))[:20]
    for reason, count in quality.get("invalid_reasons", {}).items():
        reasons[reason] = reasons.get(reason, 0) + count
    for category, data in report["groups"].items():
        if category not in groups:
            if len(groups) >= 10000:
                raise ValueError("Merged report exceeds 10000 groups")
            groups[category] = {"rows": 0, "sum": Decimal(0), "minimum": data.get("minimum", 0), "maximum": data.get("maximum", 0)}
        group = groups[category]
        group["rows"] += data["rows"]
        group["sum"] += Decimal(data.get("total_decimal", str(data["total"])))
        group["minimum"] = min(group["minimum"], data.get("minimum", 0))
        group["maximum"] = max(group["maximum"], data.get("maximum", 0))
output_groups = {key: {"rows": data["rows"], "total": float(data["sum"]), "total_decimal": str(data["sum"]),
    "minimum": data["minimum"], "maximum": data["maximum"]} for key, data in sorted(groups.items())}
result = {"version": 2, "valid_rows": valid, "invalid_rows": invalid, "groups": output_groups,
    "quality": {"invalid_reasons": reasons, "missing_category_rows": missing_groups, "examples": examples,
        "duplicate_check": "not_performed", "numeric_policy": "decimal; up to 6 fractional digits; absolute value <= 1e15"},
    "mapping": mapping, "files": files}
write_json(cfg["output_name"], result)
if cfg["final"]:
    rows = [{"category": ("'" + key if key.startswith(("=", "+", "-", "@", "\t", "\r")) else key),
        "rows": data["rows"], "total": data["total_decimal"], "average": format(round(Decimal(data["total_decimal"]) / data["rows"], 4).normalize(), "f"),
        "minimum": data["minimum"], "maximum": data["maximum"]} for key, data in output_groups.items()]
    write_csv("categories.csv", rows, ["category", "rows", "total", "average", "minimum", "maximum"])
    write_csv("quality.csv", [{"reason": reason, "rows": count} for reason, count in sorted(reasons.items())], ["reason", "rows"])
print("Combined", valid + invalid, "records across", len(groups), "groups;", invalid, "excluded")
